_comment: ★★ R177 轮「逐读点实测分区下界」的读点登记册（2026-10-28）。
★ 每个读点两条【可比】的 SQL：
A 形 = 生产原样（读 canonical 视图 public.request_logs_with_current_month）；
B 形 = 把 canonical 视图引用改写成【两臂派生表】，并把 partition_date 下界【推进两臂内部】。
★ B 形由工具从**生产部署形态**的视图体派生（不是手抄）⇒ 两形只差「有没有分区下界」这一处。
★★ 窗口参数全部取自 252 的真实数据；★ 窗口下界 = partition_date 下界（已实测不变式：
partition_date == (ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date，本地 2763 行 / 252 4558 行 均 0 例外）
⇒ ⇒ 两形的【行集完全相同】⇒ 读数可比。
★ 覆盖的窗口形态（★ 这是本轮的核心判据：「窗口是否落在同一个月分区」）：
· 7 天  ⇒ 必然同月（除非跨月界）⇒ 下界能裁掉整个月分区
· 90 天 ⇒ **必然跨月** ⇒ 下界裁不掉任何有数据的分区 ⇒ 预期【无收益、甚至略慢】
⇒ 这条是【负例】：它证明「加下界」不是无条件收益。
★ 252 是**只读**库 ⇒ 只登记 SELECT 读点；★ INSERT…SELECT 的读点
（bg/stats_minute_rollup.go 等）**不在此册**（它们是写路径）。

read_points.note: 密钥用量详情的「峰值 5 分钟」子查询 + 外层统计；默认窗口 7 天（resolveUsageTimeRange(r,7)）

variants.name: A_现状_canonical视图
variants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(failure_stage,'')='gateway' OR COALESCE(failure_detail_code,'') LIKE 'gw_%'), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(failure_stage,'')='upstream' OR (NOT success AND COALESCE(failure_stage,'')='' AND provider_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(request_status,'')<>'rate_limited')), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS bucket_count FROM request_logs_with_current_month rl2 WHERE rl2.api_key_id = $1 AND rl2.ts >= $2 AND rl2.ts < $3 GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', rl2.ts) + (FLOOR(EXTRACT(minute FROM rl2.ts) / 5) * INTERVAL '5 minutes')) peaks), 0) FROM request_logs_with_current_month WHERE api_key_id = $1 AND ts >= $2 AND ts < $3

variants.name: B_两臂加分区下界
variants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(failure_stage,'')='gateway' OR COALESCE(failure_detail_code,'') LIKE 'gw_%'), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(failure_stage,'')='upstream' OR (NOT success AND COALESCE(failure_stage,'')='' AND provider_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(request_status,'')<>'rate_limited')), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS bucket_count FROM request_logs_with_current_month rl2 WHERE rl2.api_key_id = $1 AND rl2.ts >= $2 AND rl2.ts < $3 GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', rl2.ts) + (FLOOR(EXTRACT(minute FROM rl2.ts) / 5) * INTERVAL '5 minutes')) peaks), 0) FROM request_logs_with_current_month WHERE api_key_id = $1 AND ts >= $2 AND ts < $3

read_points.note: 会话分析「模型维度分解」；默认窗口 7 天（filters.dateFrom..dateTo+1d）

variants.name: A_现状_canonical视图
variants.sql: WITH model_agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(rl.outbound_model),''),'<unknown>') AS model, COUNT(*) AS request_count, COUNT(DISTINCT rl.gw_session_id) AS session_count, COALESCE(SUM(rl.cost_usd),0) AS total_cost_usd, COALESCE(SUM(rl.prompt_tokens + rl.completion_tokens),0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(AVG(rl.latency_ms),0) AS avg_latency_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rl.request_status='failure') AS error_count FROM request_logs_with_current_month rl WHERE rl.ts >= $1 AND rl.ts < $2 GROUP BY rl.outbound_model) SELECT model, request_count, session_count, total_cost_usd, total_tokens, ROUND(avg_latency_ms)::int AS avg_latency_ms, CASE WHEN request_count > 0 THEN ROUND((error_count::numeric / request_count::numeric),3) ELSE 0 END AS error_rate FROM model_agg ORDER BY total_cost_usd DESC

variants.name: B_两臂加分区下界
variants.sql: WITH model_agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(rl.outbound_model),''),'<unknown>') AS model, COUNT(*) AS request_count, COUNT(DISTINCT rl.gw_session_id) AS session_count, COALESCE(SUM(rl.cost_usd),0) AS total_cost_usd, COALESCE(SUM(rl.prompt_tokens + rl.completion_tokens),0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(AVG(rl.latency_ms),0) AS avg_latency_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rl.request_status='failure') AS error_count FROM request_logs_with_current_month rl WHERE rl.ts >= $1 AND rl.ts < $2 GROUP BY rl.outbound_model) SELECT model, request_count, session_count, total_cost_usd, total_tokens, ROUND(avg_latency_ms)::int AS avg_latency_ms, CASE WHEN request_count > 0 THEN ROUND((error_count::numeric / request_count::numeric),3) ELSE 0 END AS error_rate FROM model_agg ORDER BY total_cost_usd DESC

variants.sql: SELECT date_trunc($1, rl.ts)::date AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT rl.gw_session_id) AS session_count, COUNT(*) AS request_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rl.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(rl.request_status,'')) = 'failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_count, SUM(COALESCE(rl.cost_usd,0)) AS total_cost_usd, SUM(COALESCE(rl.prompt_tokens,0) + COALESCE(rl.completion_tokens,0)) AS total_tokens, COUNT(DISTINCT rl.end_user_id) AS distinct_users FROM request_logs_with_current_month rl WHERE rl.ts >= $2 AND rl.ts < $3 GROUP BY date_trunc($1, rl.ts) ORDER BY date ASC
